inputs.label: A8: Maktaaral 100 ha illustrative scientific case (NOT an observed farm)

evidence_status.prices: Official BNS Turkestan 2025 published producer prices, prices do not imply 2026 contract prices
evidence_status.yields: District 2023-2025 arithmetic reference, NOT farm observed yield nor validated 2026 forecast
evidence_status.water: Order 108-NQ (2025) historical reference field-delivery norms; current Order 288-NQ in force 16 Sep 2026; values are not asserted to be current farm water entitlements or measured consumption
evidence_status.baseline: Illustrative arbitrary 50/30/20 crop shares, NOT an observed farm allocation
evidence_status.budgets: Illustrative 750,000 m3 normal-water budget and -20% stress, NOT official quota
evidence_status.other_variable_costs: Illustrative assumed full non-water/non-electric variable costs per ha, NOT statistical regional averages
evidence_status.energy_and_tariffs: Representative physical *own pump* scenario: head=25 m, overall pump-and-motor efficiency=0.65, E=ρgH/(η×3.6e6) = 0.104807692 kWh/m3; explicit non-observed assumption. The water-service charge is treated as gravity conveyance (not mechanical supplier pumping), with separate downstream own-pump energy. Grid generation-average CO2 factor 0.813 kgCO2/kWh, Kazakhstan 2025, sourced to Ember Yearly Electricity Data; NOT a national official contract factor, and not full life-cycle CO2e. Water/electricity tariffs 2.5 KZT/m3 and 30 KZT/kWh are illustrative, not farm bills.
evidence_status.nitrogen_and_diesel: Illustrative input activities per ha, NOT audited farm resource consumption
evidence_status.boundaries: Same Apr-Sep crop period, field-delivery irrigation. Partial N2O from nitrogen, diesel CO2, pumping electricity CO2e. Excludes manure, fertilizer production, soil carbon and return-flow effects.

crop_reference_rows.product: Хлопок, очищенный или не очищенный от семян
crop_reference_rows.price_source: БНС РК, среднегодовая цена производителя по Туркестанской области, 2025; Т-15-19-Г (2025) рус.xlsx, лист 1, ячейка Q32. Тг/т, без НДС. Справочный сценарий, не цена хозяйства.
crop_reference_rows.water_reference: МВРИ РК, приказ №108-НҚ от 04.06.2025, табл. 3 (историческая расчётная база). С 16.09.2026 действует №288-НҚ; соответствие значений №108 действующим нормативам на 2027 год не подтверждено.

ghg_difference.status: counterfactual scenario, not field-measured achieved saving
ghg_difference.evidence: Hypothetical A8 100-ha case; equal reporting period and factors
ghg_difference.boundary: partial N2O from applied N, diesel combustion, grid electricity; no lifecycle or all sources
ghg_difference.interpretation: modeled crop-mix difference, not measured mitigation outcome

ghg_difference_vs_infeasible_baseline.status: counterfactual scenario, not field-measured achieved saving
ghg_difference_vs_infeasible_baseline.evidence: Hypothetical A8 stressed baseline is water-infeasible; comparison is counterfactual
ghg_difference_vs_infeasible_baseline.boundary: partial N2O from applied N, diesel combustion, grid electricity; no lifecycle or all sources
ghg_difference_vs_infeasible_baseline.interpretation: modeled crop-mix difference, not measured mitigation outcome

stress.interpretation: Counterfactual infeasible baseline: not an achievable margin uplift or a field-measured water/GHG saving

provenance: Prices: BNS 2025; district yields: 2023–2025; crop water reference: Order 108-NQ, QUNAR implementation; production costs, tariffs, energy/GHG activities, baseline and budgets: explicit hypothetical assumptions. All output is an illustrative scenario.
excluded: No observed farm profit, no verified farm water quota, no actual basin savings, no out-of-sample yield forecast, no realized emissions reductions, no full life-cycle GHG or capital expenditure.
